summary: Inside the main plumbing wall, an unnamed group ("They") slowly worms its way down the grease-black stack pipes. Above them, light fills the hole they made to get inside the wall, marking their point of entry as they descend within it.

what_changes.before: Having just smashed a man-sized hole through plaster and lath to enter the wall
what_changes.after: Now concealed inside the wall, worming down the grease-black stack pipes
what_changes.evidence: slowly worming their way down the grease-black stack pipes

event_hint.one_line: The fugitives hide and descend inside a plumbing wall to get away from the cops sweeping the floor.

uncertain: Who exactly "They" are — the scene gives no names.
Whether anyone is pursuing them in this scene, or how far they descend.
